gloss: to be equipped with, to possess

definitions.gloss: to be equipped with, to possess
definitions.explanation: To have something as a built-in feature or quality.

examples.japanese: {才能|さいのう}を具えている。

notes:
KANJI DISTINCTION:
- {具|そな}える: to be equipped with (innate quality)
- {備|そな}える: to prepare, provide, equip
- {供|そな}える: to offer (to gods/ancestors)

The 具える form emphasizes inherent qualities.
